messages:
rae: opened PR for a compact migration checklist for on-prem -> VPC. Adds a kms-proxy sidecar systemd example, minimal SDK snippets (Go), CA mirroring notes, and offline bundle checksum guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5001

dom: can you paste the systemd unit and the Go snippet? I'll try in our isolated lab.

rae: systemd unit (kms-proxy sidecar, use placeholders):
```
[Unit]
Description=redwood kms-proxy sidecar
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-proxy --listen 127.0.0.1:8200 --upstream {{KMS_UPSTREAM_URL}}
Environment=REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem
User=redwood
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

Go SDK snippet (minimal):
```
os.Setenv("REDWOOD_ENDPOINT","https://private.cluster.local:9701")
os.Setenv("REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY","http://127.0.0.1:8200")
// do NOT hardcode tokens or PKCS11 PINs
client := redwood.NewClient(nil)
res, _ := client.Generate("ping")
println(res.Text)
```

sam: security: good to call out file perms (chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private-ca.pem), ensure PKCS11 env vars are host-managed, and remove any sample PINs. Also add a one-line about rotating KMS tokens after migration (link to rotation playbook).

dom: tested sidecar topology in lab; after mounting /var/run/hsm and setting PKCS11_MODULE_PATH it worked. Note: if egress is allowed instead, document recommends NAT + allowlist for 8200 and 443.

rae: added checksum example `sha256sum installer-offline-1.5.0.tar.gz` and scp target `scp installer-offline-1.5.0.tar.gz private-mirror:/var/mirrors/redwood/installer/`. Updated PR.
